title: 국립공업고등학교 설치령 / queue:ADDENDUM:24432:20130323:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Addenda to the Organization of the Small and Medium Business Administration and Its Affiliated Institutions <Presidential Decree No. 24432, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.
Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) Part of the Decree on the Establishment of National Technical High Schools shall be amended as follows:
In Articles 2 (1) and 10, "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced with "Minister of Education", respectively.
